title: Deep learning of brain–behavior dimensions identifies transdiagnostic biotypes in youth with ADHD and anxiety disorders
abstract: Nature Mental Health, Published online: 16 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s44220-026-00740-3 Attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder and anxiety disorders often co-occur in youth, but their heterogeneity complicates treatment. Here the authors use a deep learning framework to analyze functional connectivity and behavioral data, identifying brain–behavior dimensions and biotypes that clarify symptom profiles and support early risk stratification.
